name: UNO Minda Ltd
title: UNO Minda Ltd-$ - 532539 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 margin 11.3% held up on debit/credit settlements, but management flagged sizable commodity and labour cost hits ahead; FY27 capex ~INR 1,750 crore and 11% ±50bp margin guide, with pass-through still under negotiation.

utilisation.quote: 7 out of our 11 ongoing projects either commencing production or undergoing ramp-up

capex.quote: For FY27, we have planned a total capital expenditure of approximately INR 1,750 crores, comprising of around INR 650 crores towards sustaining capex and around INR 1,100 crores towards growth capex

triggers.label: Gross margin down ~1%; commodity hit ahead
triggers.quote: There is a gross margin compression of almost 1%.

triggers.label: Labour cost up ~35% in Haryana
triggers.quote: some of the labor price increases like in Haryana, the prices have been increased by almost 35%

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR 1,750 crore
triggers.quote: For FY27, we have planned a total capital expenditure of approximately INR 1,750 crores

triggers.label: Alloy wheel penetration moderating
triggers.quote: we are seeing some near-term moderation in alloy wheel penetration in our customers

triggers.label: 2W lighting order ~INR 450 crore
triggers.quote: a significant new order for unserved models, with an annual peak value of approximately INR 450 crores

guidance.quote: we continue to expect an annual EBITDA margin of around 11% plus/minus 50 basis points
we have planned a total capital expenditure of approximately INR 1,750 crores
definitely in next few years, we do expect this to cross INR 1,500 crores mark

red_flags.label: Commodity and labour cost hit ahead, pass-through unresolved
red_flags.quote: there will be expected to be an impact in the coming quarters, which are expected to be sizable.

red_flags.label: Alloy wheel penetration softening
red_flags.quote: we are seeing some near-term moderation in alloy wheel penetration in our customers

evasions.quote: Quantum of that is difficult to share, Aditya, because it's different for different businesses.

evasions.topic: Q4 trading business / LMT pass-through split
evasions.quote: I won't say much because it's very, very small.
I would not be to share if the entire 1.85 lakh capacity, how much is currently booked or not booked
